_meta.description: Train request/result contract limits (REQ-18/19/34/39). Single source of truth is crates/train/src/limits.rs (fandhe-edge-train). Cross-checked by crates/train/tests/train_contract_fixture.rs against those constants, and by trainer/tests/test_train_contract_fixture.py against trainer/src/fandhe_edge_trainer/limits.py, contract.py::SCHEMA_VERSION, contract.py::_ALLOWED_DEVICES, supervisor.py::_MAX_WORKER_STDOUT_BYTES and _MAX_WORKER_STDOUT_BYTES_WITH_VALIDATION. The max_validation_input_bytes / max_validation_id_bytes values are additionally cross-checked on the Rust side against fandhe_edge_core::infer_input::MAX_INFER_INPUT_BYTES / judgment::MAX_INPUT_ID_BYTES. Do not relax values to make a test pass; both sides implement identical values independently and a mismatch here means an intentional design change, not a bug in one side.
